comment: Units (stage 6 PR 3a-3b, ADR 0024, decisions of 2026-11-09): groups of people who walk over the map in the ticks of the live game (time.json: 10 ticks = 1 s at x1). Kinds are data, listed from the simplest: key, name, role (settlers, scouts, army, carriers, workers), requires (a technology; the first kind of every role needs none), ticksPerCell (the time to cross one flat, open cell: settlers 20 ticks = 0.5 cell a second, scouts 10, warriors 15 = 0.67 cell a second, carriers 10 (lighter, they catch up with the army), workers 20 (a work group of an area task, tasks.json)), sightCells, rangeCells (armies: how far they fight from; 1 = next to the target, more for bows, guns and artillery of later eras), people and skill (scouts: people in one party, people of the skill first; they come back with it) and an optional terrain of their own (hillsExtraPercent, mountainsExtraPercent, riverPercent, biomes: {biome key: percent}) for kinds that move differently, such as cavalry or motorized troops. A campaign marches as the last army kind its civilization knows. A migrating camp (a journey of a whole camp) walks journeyTicksPerCell. Terrain makes a cell slower (percent of a flat cell, T3): the biome's movementCost (biomes.json) x 100 (open land 100, forest and desert 200, swamp, jungle and ice 300), hills add hillsExtraPercent and mountains mountainsExtraPercent, walkable sea ice costs icePercent, and crossing a river on the edge between two cells adds riverPercent. Routes are searched with A* over walkable cells the civilization knows, looking at most at routeNodeLimit cells; a unit finds its way once for its goal and walks it, and searches again only when its way is closed. Scouts: every settlement keeps one scout party walking: a new one sets out scoutEveryYears years of action (one year = 6 s at x1) after the last came back, walks scoutTripCells cells into the land in one direction (turning at water) and comes back the way it went; it sees sightCells around itself. Settlers carry food for settlerFoodMonths months of action and eat it (as warriors do, war.json foodPerWarriorPerYear); without food hungerDeathPercent of them die every month of action. If their place is taken when they arrive they look for another within foundSearchCells cells, else they go home.
